# Wellog Privacy Policy

Published at <https://cccheungcc.github.io/wellog-privacy/> and linked from the
App Store listing.

**Do not edit `index.html` here.** It is generated from
`backend/app/privacy_policy.md` in the private app repo by
`backend/tools/publish_privacy.py`, which renders it with the same code the
backend serves at `/privacy`. Edits made here are overwritten on the next
publish.
